IT Continuity Process & Reporting Officer - HQ Brussels M/V/X
Référence 5911613
|
Créé le 29 juillet 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée indéterminée
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Logiciel - Software
Nombre d'années d'expérience :
Minimum 3 ans d'expérience
Description de la fonction
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL
As
IT Continuity process & reporting officer
, you join the enthusiastic and multidisciplinary
IT Continuity Strategy & ICRO
team (ICRO: IT Continuity & Resilience Officer)
.
Together, you are responsible to ensure our Bank ability to react to a critical failure of an application or a datacenter. Within BNPPF, you collaborate to the embedding of rules defined by Regulators such as the European Central Bank, Belgium National Bank & our Group Policies.
You will be a part of a team of 15 people with the main office located in the centre of Brussels.
AND IN DETAIL
Regulatory & Group Compliance
Ensure the IT Continuity process remains up-to-date and aligned with regulatory requirements and BNP Paribas Group standards.
Proactively review changes in requirements with Group representatives and adapt processes accordingly.
Audit & Control Support
Participate in the execution of audits and control plans, ensuring evidence is complete, accurate, and timely.
Follow up on findings, ensuring remediation actions are tracked and closed within deadlines.
Risk & Gap Mitigation
Monitor and support the implementation of risk mitigation plans.
Ensure corrective actions are prioritized, documented, and validated with stakeholders.
Validation of IT Disaster Recovery (DR) Deliverables
Review and validate IT Disaster Recovery reports.
Approve changes to application continuity levels in alignment with business impact analyses.
Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to be presented on various boards and shared with regulators.
Ensure reporting is clear, actionable, and compliant with internal/external expectations.
Examples of tasks:
Review and assess updates to Group IT Continuity procedures, regulatory requirements, and DR exercise success criteria. Evaluate the impact on BNPP Fortis' local processes.
Review and provide evidence for closure of audit recommendations, as request by control plan execution. You follow up with the teams responsible for implementation of action plans.
Review Disaster Recovery exercise reports and validate them against Group requirements and Group exercise success criteria.
You will work in close collaboration with our different stakeholders (BNPPF and Group) to prepare and collect required information.
The work arrangement for this position is 50% on-site and 50% remote work.
Profil
YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES
You bring 3 to 5 years of relevant experience;
You have proven experience in assessing and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements;
You demonstrate analytical curiosity and critical thinking, proactively identifying connections, questioning assumptions, saying ahead of emerging risks;
You thrive in a team environment, actively sharing your knowledge and insights;
You perform effectively under pressure;
You embrace continuous learning to stay ahead in a dynamic environment, actively expanding your expertise, adopting new methodologies, seeking feedback and self-improvement opportunities;
You take ownership of your responsibilities and make informed decisions;
You will bring expertise in designing and maintaining dashboards/reports;
You are proficient in English. Dutch/French knowledge is a plus;
You have a working knowledge of IT infrastructure and application development;
You are proficient in MS Office.
Compétences linguistiques
Néérlandais (atout)
Comprendre : Elémentaire (A)
Écrire : Elémentaire (A)
Lire : Elémentaire (A)
Parler : Elémentaire (A)
Avantages du poste
WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER
OUR IMPACT
As a company, we implement concrete and sustainable solutions to reduce our environmental footprint, such as saving paper and resources, recycling our waste, encouraging the use of green transport, buildings that are designed and managed to limit our impact, etc.
YOUR CAREER PERSPECTIVES
The departments that make up BNP Paribas Fortis cover a wide range of activities. You will therefore have many opportunities for 'horizontal' and 'vertical' career development.
OUR OFFER
You'll enjoy a permanent contract with an attractive salary package. You'll be working at our Brussels headquarters. We support your work-life balance by offering a mixture of in-person and remote work (50%), among other things.
OUR ENGAGEMENT
At BNP Paribas Fortis, we want to attract and retain all talent, whatever their gender, age, background or sexual orientation, and irrespective of whether they are living with a disability, as all persons have their own experiences and their own identity. All of our full-time vacancies are also open to candidates wishing to work on an 80% or 90% full-time equivalent basis.
If the function is categorized as a banking services provider function (cf. Law of 22 April 2019 establishing an oath and a disciplinary regime for the banking sector), you will also need to provide us with a 'certificate of absence of professional ban' from the FSMA confirming that you are not professionally disqualified.
